description: This line plot illustrates the memory usage of various models as a function of the number of frames processed. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Frames" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to slightly beyond 1000, with numeric tick marks at intervals of 200. The y-axis is labeled "Memory (GB)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, with numeric tick marks at intervals of 50. The plot contains five data series, all represented by solid thick lines with circular markers that have white borders. A pink line, corresponding to a redacted legend entry represented by a grey rectangle, begins at approximately 18 GB near 8 frames and remains relatively flat, ending near 64 frames. The gold line, labeled "VideoLLaMB-R", starts at approximately 18 GB near 8 frames and exhibits a very gradual, steady increase, ending at approximately 37 GB at 1024 frames. The green line, labeled "PLLaVA", also starts near 18 GB at 8 frames and increases steadily to approximately 75 GB at 1024 frames. The blue line, labeled "LLaVA-NeXT", begins near 18 GB at 8 frames and shows a steeper steady increase, reaching approximately 143 GB at 1024 frames. Finally, the purple line, labeled "VideoLLaVA", starts near 18 GB at 8 frames and exhibits a sharp, rapid increase, reaching 120 GB at 128 frames and 230 GB at 256 frames, before extending beyond the 400 GB upper limit of the y-axis prior to reaching 400 frames.
